title: Scanning a Doubled Prefix
statement: For either choice of the program parameter, all bit strings $u$ and $t$, and every natural number $n$, on input formed by writing each bit of $u$ twice and then appending $t$, the program starting at its scan label with register value $n$ and input position $0$ reaches the scan label with register value $n+|u|$ and input position $2|u|$, adding no output, in at most $3|u|$ steps. This holds for every output string already printed.
hypotheses_covered: The program parameter is a Boolean choice
The input is the doubled string $u$ followed by $t$
The input position starts at zero
